metadata.value:
The Pokemon TCG: Sun & Moon - Cosmic Eclipse Elite Trainer Box includes:

• 8 Pokemon TCG: Sun & Moon - Cosmic Eclipse booster packs

• 65 card sleeves featuring Arceus & Dialga & Palkia

• 45 Pokémon TCG Energy cards

• A player’s guide to the Sun & Moon - Cosmic Eclipse expansion

• 6 damage-counter dice

• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die

• 2 acrylic condition markers and 1 acrylic TAG TEAM GX marker

• A collector’s box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized

• A code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online

• 4 Pokemon TCG: Sun & Moon—Cosmic Eclipse booster packs

• 1 deck-building tip sheet
